== Card credits ==
Dennis Hes is credited on [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards]] with the original concept of one card.<ref name="labels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images. Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The printed concept credit names the tournament or award with the concept: "PC Volunteer Award 2007" on •Pride Of The Empire (V) ([[Virtual Block 2]]). The credited card was printed in [[Virtual Block 2]] (2009). The full list of people credited on Virtual cards is at [[Card Credits#Dennis Hes|Card Credits]].

=== Original concept (1 card) ===
{| class="wikitable sortable"
! Card !! Set !! Year !! Credit as printed
|-
| [[Pride Of The Empire (V) (Virtual Block 2)|•Pride Of The Empire (V)]] || [[Virtual Block 2]] || 2009 || "Original concept by Dennis Hes, PC Volunteer Award 2007"<ref name="labels" />
|}

''Year'' is the set's release date (Virtual Sets) or the date its official text took effect (Virtual Blocks), as given in the set's article. Alternate-image (AI, ALT) and back faces are counted as separate cards, as on [[Card Credits]].
